{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Desserts|Desserts]]

A delicious pudding dish.

==Ingredients==
* 3 [[Cookbook:egg|eggs]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (120 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[cookbook:milk|milk]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (57 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / ⅓ cup) moist [[Cookbook:sugar|sugar]]
* 2 oz (57 g / ⅓ cup) grated [[Cookbook:nutmeg|nutmeg]]
* 4 oz (110 g / ¾ cup) [[Cookbook:flour|flour]]
* 8 oz (230 g) finely-chopped [[Cookbook:suet|suet]]
* 3 oz (85 g / 1¼ cups) [[Cookbook:bread|breadcrumbs]]

==Procedure==
#Beat the eggs, strain them through a [[Cookbook:sieve|sieve]], then gradually stir them into the milk.
#Mix in the sugar and nutmeg.
#Add the flour, beating the mixture until it becomes a smooth batter.
#Gradually add suet and bread-crumbs. Mix all thoroughly together, at least half an hour before putting the pudding into a pot.
#Transfer batter into a buttered mould. Cook for 50 minutes at {{convert|350|F|C}}.
